test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The area of the sector of a circle (in cm²) of radius 7 cm and central angle 60° is:

(Take π = (22)/(7))
solution:
**Formula Used : **

Area of Sector = θ/360° × π × r²

**Calculation :**

Area = 60\360 × 22/7 × 7 × 7

⇒ 1/6 × 22/7 × 7 × 7

⇒ 22 × 7/6

⇒ 11 × 7/3

⇒ 77/3

**∴ The correct answer is 77/3.**
